label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, late in episode, agent leaning a2
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.9% of mass) and never after a rewarded trial: GO & prev_reward != 1 covers 99% of activations and 99.9% of mass, but only 4% of such steps fire. Inside that envelope the firing rate is concentrated where the agent policy argmax is a2 (91% of mass), late in the episode (rate climbs steadily with ep_trial; 48% of mass in trials 90-99, almost nothing before trial 40), and where the value head is low (55% of mass in the lowest value decile, zero above value 7.7). Runs of several unrewarded trials raise the firing rate. Also fires on d1_err / penalty-input GO steps (in_rew = -1, about 4% of mass). Does not fire at D1, essentially never at D2, never after reward. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables plus the agent own policy output (model_act); dev F1 about 0.32, mass recall 0.65. No sharper boolean was found, so the feature looks like a graded signal of low expected value / no recent reward late in the episode, biased toward a2.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, ?; D2: a1 S1 u) and trial before (GO: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, a2 S2 u; D2: a1 S1 r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=D2 & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=8.
